layout_sources: https://pypi.org/project/beancount-mbank/ 0.1.0 src/beancount_mbank/mbank.py (cp1250; semicolon; header "#Data operacji;#Data księgowania;#Opis operacji;#Tytuł;#Nadawca/Odbiorca;#Numer konta;#Kwota;#Saldo po operacji" found below a preamble; "mBank S.A." in the first lines; file name <8 digits>_<yymmdd>_<yymmdd>.csv; comma decimal)

https://github.com/yay6/ofxstatement-polish/blob/HEAD/src/ofxstatement/plugins/mbank_pl.py (cp1250; preamble keys "#Za okres:" followed by DD.MM.YYYY;DD.MM.YYYY, "#Waluta" followed by the currency, "#Numer rachunku" followed by the spaced account number, a "Łącznie" summary row, "#Saldo początkowe;<amount>"; lines of 8 fields plus a trailing empty one; account numbers wrapped in apostrophes; footer ";;;;;;#Saldo końcowe;<amount>;"; amounts may hold spaces)
notes: mBank "zestawienie operacji" CSV (the 8-column form with #Data księgowania; the transaction-list download "Lista operacji" is a 6-column variant, #Data operacji;#Opis operacji;#Rachunek;#Kategoria;#Kwota;#Saldo po operacji, see Firefly III pl/mbank). Windows-1250, CRLF, semicolon-separated, every line ending in ;. A long preamble: bank address, client, title, "#Za okres:", account type, "#Waluta" PLN, account number, rates, the turnover summary (Uznania/Obciążenia/Łącznie) and "#Saldo początkowe", then the #-prefixed header 42 lines down. Dates YYYY-MM-DD in the table (DD.MM.YYYY in the preamble); #Kwota signed with a comma decimal and a space for thousands ("6 034,00"); "#Saldo po operacji" after each line; #Tytuł and #Nadawca/Odbiorca quoted, account numbers in apostrophes. Oldest first. A footer row ";;;;;;#Saldo końcowe;6 317,55;". Expected dates are "#Data księgowania" (the card line was made a day earlier). The address lines and some preamble rows are from memory.
